set_preset_mode_with_duration.name: Set preset mode with duration
set_preset_mode_with_duration.description: Activate a preset (Boost, Party, Holiday, Leave) with a custom duration, or clear the current preset. Mode/preset/temperature can already be controlled via the generic climate.* actions - this action exists specifically to override a preset's vendor-default duration.

preset_mode.name: Preset
preset_mode.description: The preset to activate, or 'none' to clear the current preset.

target.name: Duration
target.description: Real-world duration in the preset's own unit and range — Boost: minutes (30–120, step 30); Party: hours (1–12); Leave: hours (1–12); Holiday: days (1–30). Not applicable when preset is 'none'.

set_hvac_mode_and_temperature.name: Set HVAC mode and temperature
set_hvac_mode_and_temperature.description: Set hvac_mode and a target temperature together in one reliable call. The standard climate.set_temperature action can technically accept both at once too, but does not reliably apply them together on this integration — use this action instead when you need to change both. temperature is ignored when hvac_mode is 'off' (the gateway silently rejects temperature changes while Standby is active).

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature in °C. Only applied when hvac_mode is 'auto'.
